badFontName: Enter a font name of up to 255 characters.
badSize: Enter a size from 1 to 409 points. Decimals are supported.
borderHint: Pick a line, then click a preset, an edge of the diagram or a button beside it. An edge that already has that line comes off.
codeHint: Sections positive;negative;zero, digits 0 # ?, %, dates like d mmm yyyy
dateStyleNamed: {sample} ({style, select, iso {year first} medium {written out} other {written out in full}})
edgeBorder: {edge, select, top {Top border} bottom {Bottom border} left {Left border} right {Right border} horizontal {Inside horizontal border} vertical {Inside vertical border} diagonalUp {Diagonal up border} other {Diagonal down border}}
note.accounting: Amounts with the currency label at the left edge of the cell, so the decimals line up down a column.
note.currency: Amounts with a currency label beside the digits.
note.custom: Write a format code of your own; the preview follows as you type.
note.date: Day numbers shown as calendar dates. The style follows the regional format.
note.datetime: A calendar date and a time of day together.
note.duration: Elapsed time in hours, minutes and seconds, counting on past 24 hours.
note.fraction: Decimals shown as the closest simple fraction.
note.general: No particular format: numbers, dates and text show as they were entered.
note.number: Plain numbers, with a set count of decimals, an optional thousands separator and a style for negatives.
note.percent: The value multiplied by 100, with a percent sign.
note.scientific: Numbers as a value between 1 and 10 times a power of ten, such as 1.23E+04.
note.text: Entries are kept exactly as typed, even ones that look like numbers or dates.
note.time: The time of day a value holds.
panelPreview: {panel, select, align {Alignment preview} font {Font preview} border {Border preview} other {Fill preview}}
previewEdge: Preview: {edge, select, top {Top border} bottom {Bottom border} left {Left border} right {Right border} horizontal {Inside horizontal border} vertical {Inside vertical border} diagonalUp {Diagonal up border} other {Diagonal down border}}
protectHint: Locking cells or hiding formulas has no effect until you protect the sheet (Review ▸ Protect sheet).
shrinkNeedsNoWrap: Turn off wrapping to shrink text
stackedUnsupported: Stacked vertical text is not supported
